lines.en: label osakospring5:
scene nightsky
And so the moment for me to decide how I’ll be spending my night has once again reared its ugly head — casting aside choice after choice when they all lead to the same place in the end.
lines.zh: 就这样,决定今晚如何度过的时刻,再一次探出了它丑陋的脑袋——一个又一个选项被弃置一旁,因为它们最终都通向同一个地方。

lines.en: Me. A girl. Some place where we can rest our bodies. Probably a leash if Chika is involved. Probably some light arguing if it’s Makoto. But no matter who it is, I know what I’ll be doing tonight.
lines.zh: 我。一个女孩。某个能让我们安放身体的地方。如果扯上 Chika,多半还有一条皮带。如果是 Makoto,多半还有几声轻嗔。但不管是谁,我都知道今晚要做什么。

lines.en: And there is no one who can stop me.
lines.zh: 而没有人能阻止我。

lines.en: : Hello?
: Hey. We’re hanging out tonight.
lines.zh: : 嘿。今晚我们出去逛。

lines.en: : This is the biggest plot twist I have ever experienced.
lines.zh: : 这是我此生经历过的最大剧情反转。

lines.en: : What is? Me calling you? I’ve done that before.
lines.zh: : 什么反转?我打电话给你?我干过这事啊。

lines.en: : Never right after I speak to myself about how I’m going to wind up having sex with whatever girl I see tonight.
lines.zh: : 从来没有正好在我自言自语「今晚见到的随便哪个女孩都会和我上床」之后打过。

lines.en: : Please don’t.
lines.zh: : 请别这样。

lines.en: : Too late now, Osako. You’ve toyed with fate and must pay the price.
lines.zh: : 太迟了,Osako。你戏弄了命运,必须付出代价。

lines.en: : Wow. I completely understand why you’re so popular with girls now. Who can compete with pickup lines like that?
lines.zh: : 哇。我现在完全理解你为什么这么受女孩欢迎了。这种搭讪台词,谁能敌得过?

lines.en: : Osako, I’m so miserable.
lines.zh: : Osako,我好惨。

lines.en: : Wow. I completely understand why you’re so popular with girls now. Who can compete with emotional stability like that?
lines.zh: : 哇。我现在完全理解你为什么这么受女孩欢迎了。这种情绪稳定,谁能敌得过?

lines.en: : You are one of the last people I want to hear about “emotional stability” from. And I know a lot of emotionally unstable people, Osako. A lot.
lines.zh: : 你是我最不想从其口中听到「情绪稳定」的人之一。而我认识的情绪不稳定的人可多了,Osako。多了去了。

lines.en: : Cool. So when are we meeting?
lines.zh: : 酷。那我们几点碰头?

lines.en: : I don’t know. What are we doing?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我们要干什么?

lines.en: : Something I’m pretty sure no straight guy has ever done before.
lines.zh: : 一件我相当确定没有任何直男做过的事。

lines.en: : You?
lines.zh: : 是你?

lines.en: : Yeah. Come have sex with me. I’ll send you the address now.
lines.zh: : 对。来和我做爱。我这就把地址发给你。

lines.en: I tap on my- wait, no. My phone beeps. I look at it.
lines.zh: 我点开我的——等等,不对。我的手机哔了一声。我看向它。

lines.en: : You want me to go all the way to the urban district?
lines.zh: : 你要我一直跑到市区去?

lines.en: : Yup. That’s where I am going to have sex with you. I can’t wait.
lines.zh: : 对。那就是我要和你做爱的地方。等不及了。

lines.en: scene black
: Ugh. You’re lucky I’m such a good friend.
lines.zh: : 唉。算你运气好,我是个这么好的朋友。

lines.en: : No, I’m lucky you’re such a perverted pushover. See you soon!
lines.zh: : 不,我的运气好在你就是个变态的软柿子。回头见!

lines.en: Osako hangs up the phone and I begin to make my way to the nearest subway station.
lines.zh: Osako 挂了电话,我动身前往最近的地铁站。

lines.en: scene osakowitch1
Then, after a brief ride along a line that was surprisingly busy for this time of night, I manage to catch up with her.
lines.zh: 然后,在一条对这个时间点来说出奇繁忙的线上坐了一小段,我总算赶上了她。

lines.en: : Guess who’s ready to fuck a lesbian.
lines.zh: : 猜猜谁准备好和一个蕾丝边做爱了。

lines.en: : Me. Pretty much all the time.
lines.zh: : 我。几乎随时都准备好。

lines.en: : You’re gonna have to find another one, though. I changed my mind right after I hung up on you.
lines.zh: : 不过你得另找一位了。挂掉你电话之后,我马上改了主意。

lines.en: : Not even the girls who like girls can be trusted. Where am I supposed to find another lesbian at this time of night?
lines.zh: : 连喜欢女孩的女孩都靠不住了。这个点,我上哪儿再找一个蕾丝边去?

lines.en: scene osakowitch2
: Right over there. Where we’re going.
lines.zh: : 就在那边。我们要去的地方。

lines.en: : Oh god. Are you taking me to a gay bar? Do you have any idea how torturous that will be for a chronic heterosexual like me?
lines.zh: : 我的天。你要带我去同性恋酒吧?你知道那对一个慢性异性恋来说有多煎熬吗?

lines.en: : Nope. Gayer.
lines.zh: : 不。更同性恋。

lines.en: : Than a gay bar?
lines.zh: : 比同性恋酒吧还同性恋?

lines.en: scene osakowitch3
: I said what I said and I stand by it.
lines.zh: : 我话已出口,而且坚持不改。

lines.en: : Osako...what are we doing?
lines.zh: : Osako……我们到底要干什么?

lines.en: scene osakowitch4
: So! Remember that time I talked to you about needing new hobbies? And then you dragged me to a porn shop to join the MILF of the Month Club?
lines.zh: : 那么!还记得我跟你说我需要新爱好那次吗?然后你把我拖进一家情趣用品店,加入了「本月 MILF 俱乐部」?

lines.en: : I remember how much you loved it, yeah. Why continue the search when we’ve already found the perfect thing for you?
lines.zh: : 我记得你有多爱它,是的。既然已经为你找到了完美事物,为什么还要继续寻找?

lines.en: : Because there are a bunch of other things I want to try too! And it’s my turn to subject you to something you’re likely going to hate.  Which is why we’re taking a class on witchcraft tonight.
lines.zh: : 因为还有一堆别的东西我也想试!而且轮到我让你承受一件你多半会恨的东西了。所以今晚我们要去上巫术课。

lines.en: : We are not. I don’t do things like that.
lines.zh: : 我们不去。我不干那种事。

lines.en: : We sure are. And yes you do.
lines.zh: : 我们去定了。而且你就是会。

lines.en: : I do not.
lines.zh: : 我不会。

lines.en: : Yes you do.
lines.zh: : 你就是会。

lines.en: : I...do...not.
: Sure you do! You love it.
lines.zh: : 你当然会!你爱它。

lines.en: : No means no and that is final.
lines.zh: : 不就是不,此事已定。

lines.en: scene osakowitch5
: I fucking hate you, Osako.
lines.zh: : 我他妈恨你,Osako。

lines.en: Somehow, Osako manages to drag me into a community college in the urban district that hosts a variety of silly and meaningless classes that I highly doubt anyone ever takes seriously.
lines.zh: 不知怎么地,Osako 成功把我拖进了市区一所社区大学——那里开设着五花八门又蠢又无意义的课程,我严重怀疑没有谁会把它当真。

lines.en: : Now, before we begin, I just want to remind everyone that witchcraft is far more serious and powerful than you might initially believe. But only in the hands and minds of those who trust it.
lines.zh: : 那么,在开始之前,我只想提醒各位:巫术远比你们最初想象的更严肃、更强大。但它只在那些信任它的人的手中和心中如此。

lines.en: I stand corrected and sad.
lines.zh: 我「受教」了,并且很难过。

lines.en: : Today, we’ll be learning about different types of spells that crystals can be used for, how to properly place them on altars and grids, and then a little bit of dowsing and energy healing for fun at the end!
lines.zh: : 今天,我们将学习水晶可以用于哪些不同类型的咒术、如何把它们正确摆上祭坛与能量网格,最后再玩一点探测术和能量疗愈,作为余兴!

lines.en: scene osakowitch6
: Okay. So maybe I was a little out of line with the MILF thing. But this is just low.
lines.zh: : 好。也许「MILF 那件事」我确实有点过火。但这个真的够低的。

lines.en: : Oh, come on! It’ll be fun. Especially near the end when we get to all the dowsing and energy healing.
lines.zh: : 哦,拜托!会很好玩的。尤其到了最后,等我们玩到探测术和能量疗愈的部分。

lines.en: : I don’t know what either of those two things mean, Osako.
lines.zh: : 那两样东西是什么意思,我一个都不知道,Osako。

lines.en: : Me either! But that’s what makes it fun! Maybe.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道!但这就是它好玩的地方!大概。

lines.en: scene osakowitch7
: Excuse me! First and foremost, love the top. But second, would you and your hubby mind quieting down a teensy-weensy bit so I can proceed? Thankies!
lines.zh: : 不好意思!首先,超爱你的上衣。其次,能不能请你和你家老公稍微、稍微安静一小点,好让我继续?感恩!

lines.en: : Yes. This man is my husband. And I will now demonstrate the power of women by making him shut up.
lines.zh: : 是的。这个男人是我老公。我现在就要通过让他闭嘴,来展示女性的力量。

lines.en: scene osakowitch8
: Slay, queen.
lines.zh: : 太飒了,女王。

lines.en: : Never say that again. Do you understand?
lines.zh: : 以后永远别再说这个。明白吗?

lines.en: : I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 对不起。

lines.en: : I need to hear that you understand. I will not risk hearing this a second time. Acknowledge these words, beard.
lines.zh: : 我要听到你说明白。我不会冒再听第二遍的险。给我应下这些话,大胡子。

lines.en: : I think your crystal is making you mean. It must be misaligning your chakras or something. That’s a thing, right?
lines.zh: : 我觉得是你的水晶把你变刻薄了。肯定是它让你的脉轮错位了什么的。有这么回事,对吧?

lines.en: : Never say that again either. In fact, just stay quiet for the rest of class. Thankies.
lines.zh: : 这个以后也永远别说。实际上,这节课剩下的时间你就闭嘴吧。感恩。

lines.en: scene osakowitch9
: Since when do you even like this stuff? Witchcraft seems like more of a Wakana thing, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 你什么时候开始喜欢这种东西了?巫术听起来更像是 Wakana 的菜,不是吗?

lines.en: : I don’t like this stuff. I know nothing about it. And while it definitely is more of a Wakana thing, that doesn’t mean I wouldn’t enjoy it.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢这种东西。我对它一无所知。虽然它确实更对 Wakana 的胃口,但这不代表我不会享受它。

lines.en: : Besides, every lesbian needs to attempt witchcraft at least once or they revoke our license and we start liking men.
lines.zh: : 再说,每个蕾丝边都至少得尝试一次巫术,否则她们会吊销我们的执照,我们就会开始喜欢男人。

lines.en: scene osakowitch10
: So you’ve forced me to attend the funeral for the only chance I’d ever have with you. Reiko Kobayakawa would not be proud right now.
lines.zh: : 所以你逼我来参加「我和你之间唯一的机会」的葬礼。Reiko Kobayakawa 现在绝不会为你骄傲。

lines.en: : Yeah. But on the bright side, look at all of these other lesbians you can take home to not have sex with.
lines.zh: : 是啊。但往好处想,看看这些你都可以带回家、然后不与之做爱的蕾丝边们。

lines.en: : Can we just skip to the dowsing part now? My pride is so lost at this point that I’m probably going to need the assistance of magic to unearth it.
lines.zh: : 我们能直接跳到探测术环节吗?我的自尊已经丢到这个地步,我大概需要魔法的协助才能把它挖出来。

lines.en: : Akira, there is no amount of dowsing that could help you recover what has never existed in the first place.
lines.zh: : Akira,再多探测术也帮不了你找回一开始就不存在的东西。

lines.en: : That’s where the magic comes in.
lines.zh: : 魔法的用武之地正在于此。

lines.en: : Woah! Sensei?
lines.zh: : 哇!Sensei?

lines.en: scene osakowitch11
: Oh, Noriko and Kirin are here too.
lines.zh: : 哦,Noriko 和 Kirin 也在这儿。

lines.en: : That makes sense.
lines.zh: : 那就说得通了。

lines.en: : What are you doing here? And who’s your super hot friend?
lines.zh: : 你在这儿干嘛?还有你这位超辣的朋友是谁?

lines.en: : Miss Watabe’s girlfriend. Sort of.
lines.zh: : Watabe 老师的女朋友。算是吧。

lines.en: scene osakowitch12
: Wait, really?! I remember you looking kinda different! I suddenly don’t know who to be more jealous of between you and your partner.
lines.zh: : 等等,真的吗?!我记得你长得有点不一样!我突然不知道该更嫉妒你,还是更嫉妒你伴侣了。

lines.en: : Uhh...thank you?
lines.zh: : 呃……谢谢?

lines.en: : Are you actually into this stuff, Noriko?
lines.zh: : Noriko,你真喜欢这种东西吗?

lines.en: scene osakowitch13

: I’m not not into it! I think this stuff can be kind of fun so long as you don’t buy too much into it. I’m just here because Kirin wanted to learn how to make a love potion and I wanted to be supportive.
lines.zh: : 我也谈不上不喜欢!我觉得这种东西只要你别太当真,还是挺有意思的。我来只是因为 Kirin 想学怎么调制爱情魔药,而我想支持她。

lines.en: : I do not! I just thought it would be funny! That love potion thing wasn’t serious at all!
lines.zh: : 我才没有!我只是觉得那会很好笑!爱情魔药那事根本不是认真的!

lines.en: scene osakowitch14
: Ooooooh. Riiiiiiight. Gotcha.
: Don’t make your dismissal so obviously fake either! Be a better friend and support me in my efforts to...steal your future husband or whatever!
lines.zh: : 你的敷衍也别做得那么明显!做个更好的朋友,支持我……偷走你未来老公之类的努力!

lines.en: : I’m doing the best I can, Kirin. I-
lines.zh: : 我已经尽力了,Kirin。我——

lines.en: : Ahem! Hi, new girls! Welcome to the class! Buuuuut, if it’s not a problem, could you also keep it down a tad? I already warned your friends, but this is not the kind of class you can just talk through.
lines.zh: : 咳嗯!嗨,新来的女孩们!欢迎来到本课!但——要是不麻烦的话——能不能也稍微小点声?你们的 friends 我已经警告过了,但这可不是一门能随便从头聊到尾的课。

lines.en: scene osakowitch15
: Gotcha. We’ll be good. We both love crystals. And sage. And dowsing.
lines.zh: : 懂了。我们会乖的。我们都爱水晶。还有鼠尾草。还有探测术。

lines.en: : Ah! Well, you’re in luck then! First, though...are you sure you’re in the right place? Because this class is for adults only and-
lines.zh: : 啊!那你们可来对地方了!不过首先……你们确定没走错门吗?因为这门课只限成人,而且——

lines.en: : Oh, I signed up beforehand. Stacy Fakename. Eighteen. And this is my cousin, Joanna.
lines.zh: : 哦,我提前报过名了。Stacy Fakename。十八岁。这是我表姐,Joanna。

lines.en: scene black
: Oh, great! I see both of you right here. Now, where were we?
lines.zh: : 哦,太好了!我看你们俩就在这儿。那么,我们刚才讲到哪儿了?

lines.en: : Ah, right! The identification of crystals is far more complex than merely memorizing their names and colors. Each one possesses certain qualities that-
lines.zh: : 啊,对!水晶的鉴别远比记住它们的名字和颜色复杂。每一颗都拥有某种特质,它们——

lines.en: scene osakowitch16
: Hey, you guys don’t mind if we join you, right? The last time Kirin and I came to one of these things, women kept trying to hit on us.
lines.zh: : 嘿,你们不介意我们凑过来吧?上次 Kirin 和我来这种活动,一直有女人试图搭讪我们。

lines.en: : You’ll have to ask Osako. This is her thing. I’m just being dragged along for the very painful ride.
lines.zh: : 你们得问 Osako。这是她的主意。我只是被拖着走这一趟非常痛苦的旅程。

lines.en: : Osako’s your name? Can I call you that? Or should I be more formal?
lines.zh: : 你叫 Osako?我能这么叫你吗?还是该正式一点?

lines.en: : It’s only one letter off from my family name, so it doesn’t make much of a difference either way.
lines.zh: : 它和我的姓只差一个字母,所以怎么叫都差不多。

lines.en: scene osakowitch17
: Cool! Osako it is then. I just didn’t want to be rude.
lines.zh: : 酷!那就 Osako 了。我只是不想失礼。

lines.en: : Well...thanks. Are you always this polite?
lines.zh: : 这个……谢了。你一直都这么有礼貌吗?

lines.en: : I think she just wants to fuck you.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她只是想和你上床。

lines.en: : Yeah, I was thinking the same thing.
lines.zh: : 对,我也正这么想。

lines.en: scene osakowitch18
: Hahah! You guys are so funny!
lines.zh: : 哈哈!你们真逗!

lines.en: : She didn’t deny it.
lines.zh: : 她没否认。

lines.en: : She rarely ever does. It’s cool that you’re into this stuff though, Osako! Maybe you can give Kirin and I some tips on potioncraft?
lines.zh: : 她很少否认。不过你喜欢这种东西挺酷的,Osako!也许你能给我和 Kirin 传授点调药的窍门?

lines.en: scene osakowitch19
: Oh, no. I’m not into it or anything. This is Witchcraft 101. I’m just...trying out a bunch of new hobbies and dragging who I can only assume is your teacher along with me to make him suffer.
lines.zh: : 哦,不。我谈不上喜欢。这是巫术入门课。我只是……在尝试一堆新爱好,并拖上一位我推测是你们老师的人陪我同行,好让他受苦。

lines.en: : We’re good friends. It just doesn’t look like it.
lines.zh: : 我们是好朋友。只是看起来不像。

lines.en: : A little self-searching, then? Fun! Kirin’s doing the same thing right now.
lines.zh: : 一点自我探索,是吧?有趣!Kirin 现在也在做同样的事。

lines.en: : Maybe the two of us can find new hobbies...in each other.
lines.zh: : 说不定我们两个能找到新爱好……在彼此身上。

lines.en: scene osakowitch20
: What does that even mean?
lines.zh: : 这话到底什么意思?

lines.en: : What do you want it to mean?
lines.zh: : 你想让它是什么意思?

lines.en: : So is that love potion for me? Or-
lines.zh: : 所以那瓶爱情魔药是为我调的?还是——

lines.en: scene osakowitch21
: There is no potion, damn it! It was a joke!
lines.zh: : 根本没有什么魔药,该死!那是个玩笑!

lines.en: : Another one for the harem, huh?
lines.zh: : 后宫又添一员,是吧?

lines.en: : You’ll fall for me too once they revoke your lesbian license. Which they may very well do at this rate since none of us have been paying attention to the class at all.
lines.zh: : 等她们吊销你的蕾丝边执照,你也会迷上我的。照这个势头,她们很可能真会吊销,毕竟我们没一个人在听课。

lines.en: : I think I’ve got a little while left until they come for me. They normally wait until you hit thirty to start knocking on your door.
lines.zh: : 我觉得离她们来抓我还有一段时间。她们一般要等你满三十岁,才开始敲门。

lines.en: scene osakowitch22
: I’m assuming you’re the same age as Wakana, then?
lines.zh: : 那我猜你和 Wakana 同龄?

lines.en: : Uh...yeah. But...you call her by her first name too? She hates when students do that.
lines.zh: : 呃……对。可是……你也直呼她的名字?学生那样做她很讨厌的。

lines.en: : I’m an exception. Wakana and I are great friends. She was actually my teacher before Akira-sensei was.
lines.zh: : 我是例外。Wakana 和我是挚友。实际上,在 Akira 老师之前,她是我的老师。

lines.en: : And you call...him by his first name?
lines.zh: : 而你叫……他,也是直呼名字?

lines.en: : Of course. He’s my Onii-chan.
lines.zh: : 当然。他是我 Onii-chan。

lines.en: scene osakowitch23
: You’re related?
lines.zh: : 你们是亲戚?

lines.en: : Only when my clothes are on! Once they’re off, I’m whatever he wants me to be! Which is totally fine since I’m Stacy Fakename! Eighteen.
lines.zh: : 只有穿着衣服的时候是!一旦脱了,我就是他想要我成为的任何东西!这完全没问题,因为我是 Stacy Fakename!十八岁。

lines.en: scene osakowitch24
: This harem thing really never ends, does it?
lines.zh: : 这后宫真是永远没有尽头,对吧?

lines.en: : Now do you see how hard my life is?
lines.zh: : 现在你明白我的人生有多难了吧?

lines.en: : The education system has failed us in so many ways, hasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 教育体系在这么多方面辜负了我们,不是吗?

lines.en: : You joke, but I imagine you’d be pretty popular with the girls in our school too, Osako.
lines.zh: : 你是在开玩笑,但我想,在我们学校,你也会很受女孩们欢迎的,Osako。

lines.en: scene osakowitch25
: Me? No way. I don’t buy that at all.
lines.zh: : 我?不会吧。这我完全不信。

lines.en: : I guess she does kind of have that same sort of...Otoha thing going on for her, doesn’t she? Cool and princely aura, but still kind of feminine as a whole.
lines.zh: : 我猜她身上确实有那种……和 Otoha 一样的气质,对吧?又酷又贵气的气场,但整体上仍然有种女性味。

lines.en: : Wakana, I’d understand. She’s cool. And super hot. But I’m just, like...Girl C.
lines.zh: : 要说是 Wakana,我还能理解。她又酷又超辣。但我只是,怎么说……女孩 C。

lines.en: : Girl C?
lines.zh: : 女孩 C?

lines.en: : Yeah. You know. Like...a background character. There’s nothing about me that really stands out.
lines.zh: : 对。你懂的。就像……一个背景角色。我身上没有什么真正出彩的地方。

lines.en: : I mean...Wakana does have her own sort of...mini...harem...cult...thing. But I don’t think you’re “Girl C” at all, Osako.
lines.zh: : 这个嘛……Wakana 确实有她自己的那种……迷你……后宫……教团……之类的玩意。但我完全不觉得你是「女孩 C」,Osako。

lines.en: : You have known me for ninety seconds.
lines.zh: : 你认识我一共九十秒。

lines.en: : Yeah! Which was more than enough to make Kirin want to bang you.
lines.zh: : 对!而这就已经足够让 Kirin 想上你了。

lines.en: : And I’ve only known her for ninety seconds, but I feel like that isn’t saying much.
lines.zh: : 而我认识她也只有九十秒,但我觉得这说服力不太够。

lines.en: scene osakowitch26
: I’m hormonal, okay?! I’d cum from a fucking hug at this point in my life!
lines.zh: : 我正处于荷尔蒙期,行吗?!照我人生眼下这个阶段,一个该死的拥抱都能让我去!

lines.en: : Isn’t she just the cutest?
lines.zh: : 她是不是可爱到家了?

lines.en: : Don’t compliment her too much or she might cum from that too.
lines.zh: : 别夸她夸得太狠,不然她连这个也能去。

lines.en: scene osakowitch27
: Aaaah! Fuck you guys! I’m going to the bathroom!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊!去你们的!我去洗手间了!

lines.en: : Bye Kirin! Don’t cum!
lines.zh: : 拜拜 Kirin!不许去!

lines.en: : So is just...everyone in your school unhinged?
lines.zh: : 所以说……你们学校的人是不是全都不正常?

lines.en: : Pretty much everyone except that Otoha girl that you were compared to a second ago, yeah.
lines.zh: : 除了刚才拿来和你相提并论的那个 Otoha 之外,差不多全都不正常,是的。

lines.en: scene osakowitch28
: Great. So she’s Girl B and I’m Girl C. No harems here. Not like I’d know what to do with one anyway when I’ve only ever had eyes for one person.
lines.zh: : 太好了。所以她是女孩 B,我是女孩 C。这儿可没有后宫。反正我也不知道拿后宫干什么用——毕竟我眼里从来只有一个人。

lines.en: : Really? I figured you’d have been really popular in school, Osako. Otoha definitely was at Kumon-mi Academy. It wasn’t until she was among all the misfits that she started fading into obscurity.
lines.zh: : 真的?我还以为你在学校会很受欢迎呢,Osako。Otoha 在 Kumon-mi 学园就绝对是。直到她落进一群格格不入的家伙中间,才开始淡出视线。

lines.en: scene osakowitch29
: I mean, like...I had friends. But I was active in sports clubs and stuff and...I don’t know. I wasn’t that type of popular.
lines.zh: : 这个嘛,就像……我也有朋友。但我在体育社团之类的地方比较活跃,而且……我不知道。我不是那种「受欢迎」。

lines.en: : Hell, I didn’t even really start thinking about romance and stuff until college. Before that, Girl C would have been a compliment.
lines.zh: : 见鬼,我甚至直到大学才开始认真想恋爱什么的。在那之前,「女孩 C」算得上夸奖。

lines.en: : You’ve just gotta wait for a spinoff then!
lines.zh: : 那你就等着等一部衍生剧吧!

lines.en: scene osakowitch30
: Hm?
: It’s not unheard of for side characters to get spinoffs where they get to be the star! And that’s what you’re trying to figure out now by taking classes you’re not totally interested in, right?
lines.zh: : 配角拿到衍生剧、自己当主角,这种事并非没有先例!而你现在上着这些你并不真正感兴趣的课程,不就是在琢磨这个吗?

lines.en: : Uhh...I mean...I don’t know if I’d say I’m trying to become the main character. But feeling a little more like...someone who doesn’t solely exist for someone else would be nice.
lines.zh: : 呃……就是说……我不确定我会不会说自己想当主角。但如果能多一点感觉像……一个并非只为他人而存在的什么人,那就挺好的。

lines.en: : Well, you’ve picked the right person to accompany you on your journey then.
lines.zh: : 那么,你这趟旅途的同伴,可算是选对人了。

lines.en: scene osakowitch31
: This guy? You’re kidding.
lines.zh: : 这家伙?你在开玩笑吧。

lines.en: : Would the two of you think less of me if I mentioned how that kind of hurt?
lines.zh: : 要是我说这话有点扎心,你们俩会不会看不起我?

lines.en: : See what I mean? You’re talking about Wakana, right? How she’s along for the journey? Because I’ve been trying to keep her out of it. I’m-
lines.zh: : 看到我说的意思了吧?你说的是 Wakana,对吧?说她陪你踏上旅程什么的?因为我一直在试着让她别掺和进来。我——

lines.en: : No, I’m talking about Sensei.
lines.zh: : 不,我说的是 Sensei。

lines.en: : As weird as it is, he manages to bring out the best in people way more often than you’d think.
lines.zh: : 虽然说出来很怪,但他把人们最好的一面勾出来的频率,远超你的想象。

lines.en: : No, I just think everyone else looks way better by comparison.
lines.zh: : 不,我只是觉得,相比之下,其他所有人都好看太多了。

lines.en: : What he said.
lines.zh: : 附议他说的。

lines.en: : Well, both of you have self-esteem issues then.
lines.zh: : 那么好,你们俩都有自尊问题。

lines.en: scene osakowitch32
: Well, she’s got us there.
lines.zh: : 好吧,这点被她说中了。

lines.en: : Why are you holding my hand?
lines.zh: : 你为什么握着我的手?

lines.en: : Because I’m in love with you.
lines.zh: : 因为我爱上你了。

lines.en: scene osakowitch33
: What’s your name again? Stacy?
lines.zh: : 你叫什么来着?Stacy?

lines.en: : Or Noriko. Either one works.
lines.zh: : 或者 Noriko。哪个都行。

lines.en: : Strong name.
lines.zh: : 强大的名字。

lines.en: : I’m a strong girl.
lines.zh: : 我是个强大的女孩。

lines.en: : And the man behind you is the one who helped turn me into that.
lines.zh: : 而你身后那个男人,就是帮我把「我」锻造成这样的人。

lines.en: : Something tells me you’d have turned out just fine with or without him.
lines.zh: : 有种直觉告诉我,无论有没有他,你本来都会安然长成如今的模样。

lines.en: : Maybe. Maybe not. And maybe your whole self-discovery thing won’t really be influenced by him either.
lines.zh: : 也许。也许不。也许你这整个自我探索之旅,也未必真的会被他影响。

lines.en: : But I can tell from just these ninety...probably a hundred-twenty seconds now, that both of you can help each other.
lines.zh: : 但只凭这九十……现在大概一百二十秒,我就能看出,你们俩可以互相帮衬。

lines.en: scene osakowitch34
: Well, I hope so. Because we both clearly need it.
lines.zh: : 嗯,希望如此。因为很明显,我们俩都需要。

lines.en: : Misery is contagious. All we’re going to do is kill each other.
lines.zh: : 不幸是会传染的。我们俩到头来只会互相杀死对方。

lines.en: scene osakowitch35
: I changed my mind. I love you again.
lines.zh: : 我改主意了。我又爱你了。

lines.en: : Learn how to love me without touching me.
lines.zh: : 学会在不碰我的前提下爱我。

lines.en: scene black
: Anyways! I’ll be right back. I’m gonna go make sure Kirin didn’t fall into the toilet and-
lines.zh: : 总之!我马上回来。我去确认一下 Kirin 有没有掉进马桶,然后——

lines.en: : Actually, don’t bother! Because all three of you are now being ejected from the class for disturbing everyone else and ruining meditation time!
lines.zh: : 其实,不必麻烦了!因为你们三位现在都要被逐出课堂,罪名是打扰他人、毁掉冥想时间!

lines.en: : Noooo, but we didn’t even get to the dowsing yet! That was supposed to be the fun part!
lines.zh: : 不要啊,可我们还没到探测术呢!那本来是最好玩的部分!

lines.en: : Witchcraft isn’t about fun! It’s about explaining and manipulating the unknown! Which is something you’d know if you paid attention for more than five seconds!
lines.zh: : 巫术不是为了好玩!它是为了解释和操纵未知!要是你们能集中注意力超过五秒,就会知道这一点!

lines.en: : Yeah, well maybe it’s just really fucking boring! Come on, Akira. Let’s get drunk and have heterosexual sex with each other. Which is a thing we definitely do!
lines.zh: : 是吗,也许它就是他妈的无聊透顶!走,Akira。我们去喝个烂醉,然后彼此进行异性恋性行为。我们绝对常干这种事!

lines.en: : Are my dreams coming true or do we just need to keep deceiving them for reasons I don’t understand?
lines.zh: : 是我的梦想成真了,还是我们得继续为了某些我不理解的原因欺骗它们?

lines.en: : Confuse the lesbians! Scatter!
lines.zh: : 迷惑蕾丝边们!散!

lines.en: Osako pulls me out of the classroom so quickly that I’m pretty sure she dislocates my shoulder.
lines.zh: Osako 把我拽出教室的速度快到我相当确定,她把我的肩膀拽脱臼了。
